    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    dist = instance["distance_matrix"]

        return []

        s = 0
        for n in route:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = dist[depot][route[0]] + dist[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += dist[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def best_insertion_pos(route, node):
        if not route:
            return 0, dist[depot][node] + dist[node][depot]
        best_pos = 0
        best_delta = None
        for pos in range(len(route) + 1):
            prev = depot if pos == 0 else route[pos - 1]
            nxt = depot if pos == len(route) else route[pos]
            delta = dist[prev][node] + dist[node][nxt] - dist[prev][nxt]
            if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta:
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = pos
        return best_pos, best_delta

            return route
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            for i in range(n - 2):
                a = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
                b = route[i]
                for j in range(i + 1, n - 1):
                    c = route[j]
                    d = depot if j == n - 1 else route[j + 1]
                    old = dist[a][b] + dist[c][d]
                    new = dist[a][c] + dist[b][d]

                        improved = True

        unserved.pop(0)
        route = [seed]

            best_node = None
            best_key = None

                        if gain > best_gain + 1e-12:
                            best_gain = gain
                            best_swap = (i, j, a, b)
        if best_swap is not None and best_gain > 1e-12:
            i, j, a, b = best_swap
            routes[i][a], routes[j][b] = routes[j][b], routes[i][a]
            routes[i] = two_opt(routes[i])
            routes[j] = two_opt(routes[j])
            changed = True

    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    return routes
